title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Triage Agent summaries for DLP alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR
summary: Hold for corrections to billing, scheduling and remediation scope. Deployment does not determine when capacity billing starts, automatic scheduling is optional, and Teams remediation reminders apply only to eligible SharePoint and OneDrive alerts; the governance prose also incorrectly includes deployment among Purview-only actions.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to expose Data Security Triage Agent summaries and categorizations on DLP alerts in Defender XDR.
claims.quote: Data Security Triage Agent summaries and categorizations for DLP alerts will be made available in DLP Alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; changes

Will Microsoft Security Copilot agents be automatically enabled?

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; controls[0].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: Management, editing and disabling require Purview even when deployment happened in Defender XDR.
claims.quote: The Triage Agent can be deployed from both Microsoft Purview and Defender XDR portals, but can only be managed, edited, and disabled from the Microsoft Purview portal.

claims.claim: Only one instance of this agent can exist in a tenant regardless of deployment portal.
claims.quote: There can be only one instance of each agent in a tenant, regardless of the portal in which it was deployed.

claims.claim: Admins and analysts in a tenant without an agent see a setup banner or card on the alerts page.
claims.quote: Any admin or analyst for a tenant (with no agent deployed) sees a banner or card on alerts page for Triage agent setup.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout; Why it matters
claims.claim: Get started in the Defender XDR alert banner starts deployment with default settings.
claims.quote: Click on "Get started" to start the agent with default settings.

claims.claim: Deployment is the point where spend starts.
claims.quote: With the inclusion model, which provides 400 SCUs per 1,000 user licenses, there's no hourly provisioned capacity. Instead, the same two scenarios would deduct 3.5 SCUs from the monthly SCU allocation.
claims.fix: Replace 'deployment is the point where spend starts (SCUs are consumed as alerts are triaged)' with 'the agent consumes SCUs as it triages alerts'. Consumption can use included capacity, and the cited Purview billing page separately says provisioned SCUs are billed in hourly blocks; deployment is not a universal billing start.

claims.claim: For an alert with 10 or more files, the agent uses the top 10 files for its summary.
claims.quote: In DLP, the triage agent selects the top 10 risky files based on the number of policy classifier hits, the file size, and the most recent file access time.

claims.claim: The agent triages files up to 2 MB.
claims.quote: Agents triage files up to 2 MB in size.

select Agents.
